title: The Method of Hiding a Body
description:
Spine-Chilling Gaming ExperienceYou will play as a resentful ghost, prowling the deep mountains at midnight, possessing the living, and constantly searching for your own corpse. After the roles of human and ghost are reversed, you will unleash your grudges upon the innocent, controlling their life and death.
Why did I die while you all live on, this is not fair!!!GameplayThe game contains an impressive story and light puzzle-solving elements.Psychological HorrorThe most terrifying thing is often the ugliest side of human nature. Due to the constraints of reality, people have to hide their evil intentions, but ghosts do not.VHS Camera styleThe visuals have a nostalgic, retro graininess, as well as blurriness, graininess, and color distortion effects, giving the game a unique old-world feel. These effects will provide players with a distinct horror experience, reminiscent of those terrifying memories from past eras.
These effects can be turned off.Six EndingsThis game has six vastly different endings, and players will receive a surprise after completing all of them.
description_short: A story-driven horror puzzle game where the player takes on the role of a resentful ghost, possessing others in order to search for her own corpse.
